question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage suggests **the narrator made a logical assumption about his wife's whereabouts.**
 
• **"Concluded"** **fits well here as it means to make a judgement based on given information.**
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 2 is '**concluded**'.

Complete Passage: *At the breakfast table the next morning, there was no sign of my wife. I **concluded**__ she was sleeping late, but Gladolia, upon being questioned, only shook her head, mumbled something, and turned the whites of her eyes up to the ceiling. I was glad when the meal was finished and hurried to the library for another try at that story.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Examined** (जाँच की): "Examined" means to inspect someone or something in detail to determine their nature or condition, which** **is not** **the right choice for this context.
 
• **Accepted** (स्वीकार किया): "Accepted" means to consent to receive or undertake (something offered), which implies passively receiving rather than actively concluding based on observation.
 
• **Decided** (निर्णय लिया): "Decided" focuses on making a choice after consideration, which suggests more deliberation than the context indicates.
